defects.observation: Reviewer actions were not durably persisted or reload-verifiable.
defects.rootCause: The reviewer workspace had no governed project-candidate decision endpoint or ledger.
defects.focusedFix: Added an append-only candidate-authority reviewer ledger, governed API endpoint, UI controls, reload verification, and audit references.
defects.regressionEvidence: Seven action types persisted and replayed across three scenarios.

defects.observation: Consequential canonical-service metadata was not accessible in stage candidate details.
defects.rootCause: The stage panel rendered headline operations but omitted traceability and decision-support fields.
defects.focusedFix: Exposed requirements, quality drivers, risks, decisions, evidence, alternatives, assumptions, affected objects, authority, and review posture.
defects.regressionEvidence: 808 of 808 applicable obligations were visible, actionable, or traceable.

defects.observation: An upstream design-intent change did not reliably stale and regenerate affected downstream candidates.
defects.rootCause: Design-intent setters did not run selective generated-candidate staleness, and stale same-ID candidates blocked replacement.
defects.focusedFix: Applied selective stale marking on design-intent changes and allowed stale candidate replacement in place while preserving candidate authority.
defects.regressionEvidence: All three journeys observed downstream staleness and regenerated only the affected stage.

defects.observation: Rejected candidates could remain in assembled SDD material.
defects.rootCause: The SDD composer did not exclude rejected nodes and dependent graph material.
defects.focusedFix: Filtered rejected nodes, dependent edges and interfaces, and rejected decisions in both engine copies.
defects.regressionEvidence: Rejected candidate labels were absent from all three scenario SDDs.
